_about: The six Quick cleanup cards on the Pick step, in Page order, and the default pace and confirm settings. Keep always wins over every card. Cards only build a cleanup list; nothing is deleted without the owner's Approve.

quick_cleanups.title: Delete everything
quick_cleanups.detail: Every post, reply, quote post and repost, except posts you mark Keep.

quick_cleanups.title: Delete my oldest posts (older than 2 years)
quick_cleanups.detail: Everything older than 2 years. Newer posts stay.

quick_cleanups.title: Delete a past era
quick_cleanups.detail: Starts with your oldest two years. Change the range on this card.

quick_cleanups.title: Delete all my replies
quick_cleanups.detail: Removes your replies only. Your own posts, quote posts and reposts stay.

quick_cleanups.title: Delete posts and replies with few likes
quick_cleanups.detail: Set a like cap for posts, replies, or both. A dash means that type is left alone. Reposts are not affected.
